day.headline: Sensex and Nifty snapped a four-session losing streak, closing at the day's high on buying in metals, pharma and Kotak Bank after its Q2 results, even as Brent stayed near $114.
day.summary: The Sensex rose 482.92 points to 73,606.75 and the Nifty 50 rose 153.20 points to 22,753.20, recovering from a weak open of more than 500 points down. Midcaps and smallcaps outperformed, but analysts called it selective buying rather than a durable bottom, with high crude, a weaker rupee (95.19/$) and the US Fed decision due later in the week as the main worries. FIIs sold a net ₹1,462 cr while DIIs bought ₹2,610 cr.

items.title: Sensex +483, Nifty 22,753: four-day losing streak ends on metal, pharma buying
items.why: Equity fund NAVs got some relief after a week in which the Nifty fell 2.36%, but the bounce was narrow, so clients should not read it as a turnaround. Metals (+2.2%), pharma (+1.8%) and oil & gas (+1.3%) led, while FMCG, media and consumer durables fell; Brent eased to about $114.50 from a near six-month high of $117.

items.title: Kotak Mahindra Bank rises after Q2: profit +29.5% to ₹4,212 cr, brokerages raise targets
items.why: Kotak is widely held in large-cap, flexi-cap and banking funds, so the positive reaction to its Saturday results helped those NAVs. Standalone net profit rose 29.5% YoY (helped by higher other income), NII (net interest income, the gap between interest earned and paid) rose 15.7% to ₹8,459 cr, and gross NPA improved to 1.04%, but margin (NIM) slipped to 4.31%. The stock rose as much as 3.6% early (₹446.30 high vs ₹430.50 previous close) and was among the Sensex gainers at close; Jefferies (₹520) and JPMorgan (₹492) raised targets.

items.title: Lenders hit: Shriram Finance −4.6% on AUM guidance cut, AU SFB −6.9% after Q2
items.why: Funds with NBFC or small finance bank exposure took a knock, a reminder that financials can drag even on an up day. Nifty Small Finance Banks & MFIs fell 3.11% and Nifty NBFC fell 1.58%; Shriram Finance was the top Nifty loser after cutting its assets-under-management growth guidance, and City Union Bank (−6.32%) and Five-Star Business Finance (−7.48%) also fell.

items.title: Dr Reddy's jumps nearly 7% on Q2; JSW Steel +6.3% leads metals
items.why: Pharma and healthcare funds outperformed, with Nifty Pharma up 1.76%. Dr Reddy's rose on strong Q2 results and a positive brokerage note; Infosys ended over 1% higher despite missing Q2 estimates. Note: sources differ on Sun Pharma — one listed it among gainers, the ANI close report among laggards.

items.title: AMFI data: Kerala, Chhattisgarh, Telangana outpace industry AUM growth; Karnataka +7.4%
items.why: Useful context for a Bangalore distributor: Karnataka's average AUM rose 7.4% (₹5.68 lakh cr to ₹6.10 lakh cr) between April and September 2026, slightly ahead of the industry's 6.3% (₹81.94 lakh cr to ₹87.09 lakh cr). Kerala led at +13%; these are April-to-September changes, not year-on-year.

items.title: NFO week: Kotak Nifty Realty Index, Invesco Silver ETF + FoF, UTI Financial Services Debt, ICICI Pru BSE Power ETF
items.why: Silver FoF NFOs are opening even while gold FoFs are restricted. These are new thematic and passive options; present them by category, not as picks. Kotak Nifty Realty Index Fund runs 26/10–09/11 (min ₹1,000). Invesco India Silver ETF (min ₹5,000) and Silver ETF FoF (min ₹1,000) run 27/10–09/11. UTI Financial Services Debt Fund ran 27/10–02/11, and ICICI Prudential BSE Power ETF ran 26/10–30/10.
